title: BlitzCoin: Fully Decentralized Hardware Power Management for Accelerator-Rich SoCs
problem: Centralized power-management strategies face response time and scalability constraints when applied to next-generation SoCs with tens to hundreds of cores and accelerators. Existing approaches cannot efficiently scale to large, heterogeneous systems.
motivation: Efficient power management is critical for large accelerator-rich SoCs to achieve high performance and energy efficiency at scale.
method: BlitzCoin uses a fully decentralized hardware power-management strategy that eliminates centralized control bottlenecks. It implements optimized unified voltage and frequency regulation through distributed hardware logic. Local decision-making across components enables faster response times while maintaining coordinated power constraints across the chip.
key_novelty: Fully decentralized hardware-based power management that achieves 8-12× faster response times compared to centralized approaches.
contributions: Decentralized hardware power-management architecture for accelerator-rich SoCs with hundreds of components
Optimized unified voltage and frequency regulation mechanisms
8×-12× reduction in power-management response time versus centralized strategies
Silicon validation on 12nm many-accelerator SoC with <1% area overhead

metrics.other: 8×-12× response time reduction, enables 7×-13× larger SoCs
